description: Names a new external party for the portal (#534) — never creates a user, sends no invitation, and never counts toward billable seats. Returns a signed token (#602 — id.version.hmac, not a bare opaque value); what content it can reach is not yet wired to anything (row scoping ships separately).

email.description: Optional — for your own reference, not used for delivery yet.

expires_at.description: ISO datetime. Absent = never expires. An expired token is refused the same way a revoked one is.

label.description: Display name for this recipient, e.g. a client's company name.

name: create_portal_recipient
title: Create a portal recipient
